market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely choppy: oil-driven inflation vs. Fed easing tug-of-war. Tech leads on AI catalysts (GPT-6, Snowflake) but Nvidia obligation overhang caps upside. EM outperforms. 30-yr mortgage and diesel prices are key inflation gauges. 5-10% pullback risk if Iran escalates further.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish but requires diversification beyond hardware. Venezuela oil normalization and data-center power demand (nuclear, gas) reshape energy landscape. K-shaped economy persists; EM growth outpaces developed markets. Geopolitical fragmentation (Iran, Ukraine, India policy) keeps volatility elevated through 2027.
